scope: full train/pilot and current full ID/OOD evaluations

budget_metric_definition.pass_at_k: exact probability that a uniformly sampled size-k subset contains at least one correct candidate
budget_metric_definition.selection_at_k: exact expected correctness of the highest-scored candidate in a uniformly sampled size-k subset
budget_metric_definition.insufficient_candidates: excluded for that k and reported through coverage
